params.name: start

terms.summary: A list of terms and their descriptions.

params.name: tight
params.summary: Defines the default spacing of the term list. If it is false, the items are spaced apart with paragraph spacing. If it is true, they use paragraph leading instead. This makes the list more compact, which can look better if the items are short.

params.name: separator
params.summary: The separator between the item and the description.

params.name: indent
params.summary: The indentation of each item.

params.name: spacing
params.summary: The spacing between the items of the term list.

params.name: children
params.summary: The term list’s children.

params.name: term
params.summary: The term described by the list item.

params.name: description
params.summary: The description of the term.

text.summary: Customizes the look and layout of text in a variety of ways.

params.name: font
params.summary: A font family descriptor or priority list of font family descriptors.

params.name: fallback
params.summary: Whether to allow last resort font fallback when the primary font list contains no match. This lets Typst search through all available fonts for the most similar one that has the necessary glyphs.

params.name: style
params.summary: The desired font style.

params.name: weight
params.summary: The desired thickness of the font’s glyphs. Accepts an integer between 100 and 900 or one of the predefined weight names. When the desired weight is not available, Typst selects the font from the family that is closest in weight.

params.name: stretch
params.summary: The desired width of the glyphs. Accepts a ratio between 50% and 200%. When the desired width is not available, Typst selects the font from the family that is closest in stretch. This will only stretch the text if a condensed or expanded version of the font is available.

params.name: size
params.summary: The size of the glyphs. This value forms the basis of the em unit: 1em is equivalent to the font size.

params.name: fill
params.summary: The glyph fill paint.

params.name: stroke
params.summary: How to stroke the text.

params.name: tracking
params.summary: The amount of space that should be added between characters.

params.name: spacing
params.summary: The amount of space between words.

params.name: baseline
params.summary: An amount to shift the text baseline by.

params.name: overhang
params.summary: Whether certain glyphs can hang over into the margin in justified text. This can make justification visually more pleasing.

params.name: lang
params.summary: An ISO 639-1/2/3 language code.

params.name: region
params.summary: An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code.

params.name: script
params.summary: The OpenType writing script.

params.name: dir
params.summary: The dominant direction for text and inline objects. Possible values are:

params.name: hyphenate
params.summary: Whether to hyphenate text to improve line breaking. When auto, text will be hyphenated if and only if justification is enabled.

params.name: costs
params.summary: The “cost” of various choices when laying out text. A higher cost means the layout engine will make the choice less often. Costs are specified as a ratio of the default cost, so 50% will make text layout twice as eager to make a given choice, while 200% will make it half as eager.

params.name: kerning
params.summary: Whether to apply kerning.

params.name: alternates
params.summary: Whether to apply stylistic alternates.

params.name: ligatures
params.summary: Whether standard ligatures are active.

params.name: fractions
params.summary: Whether to turn numbers into fractions. Setting this to true enables the OpenType frac font feature.

params.name: features
params.summary: Raw OpenType features to apply.

params.name: variations
params.summary: Raw OpenType font variations to apply.

params.name: body
params.summary: Content in which all text is styled according to the other arguments.

params.name: text
params.summary: The text.

params.name: relative

params.name: value

params.name: pretty
params.summary: Whether to pretty-print the resulting TOML.

params.name: extent
params.summary: The amount by which to extend the line beyond (or within if negative) the content.

params.name: evade
params.summary: Whether the line skips sections in which it would collide with the glyphs.

params.name: background
params.summary: Whether the line is placed behind the content it underlines.

params.name: body

upper.summary: Converts a string or content to uppercase.

params.name: text
params.summary: The text to convert to uppercase.

v.summary: Inserts vertical spacing into a flow of blocks.

params.name: amount
params.summary: How much spacing to insert.

params.name: weak
params.summary: If true, the spacing collapses at the start or end of a flow. Moreover, from multiple adjacent weak spacings all but the largest one collapse. Weak spacings will always collapse adjacent paragraph spacing, even if the paragraph spacing is larger.

version.summary: A version with an arbitrary number of components.

params.name: components
params.summary: The components of the version (array arguments are flattened)

version.at.summary: Retrieves a component of a version.

params.name: index
params.summary: The index at which to retrieve the component. If negative, indexes from the back of the explicitly given components.
